entries.Original: Draw ants border around specific abilities. /pants to configure.
entries.Translated: 在特定技能周围绘制蚂蚁边框。/pants 进行配置。

entries.Original: Charged abilities only get ants for the final charge
entries.Translated: 充能技能仅在最后一层充能时显示蚂蚁边框

entries.Original: Don't hide ants while you're casting
entries.Translated: 施法期间不隐藏蚂蚁边框

entries.Original: Only show custom ants for actions your character can use (job level restriction).
entries.Translated: 仅对角色可使用的技能显示自定义蚂蚁边框（职业等级限制）。

entries.Original: Only show custom ants while in combat
entries.Translated: 仅在战斗中显示自定义蚂蚁边框

entries.Original: Set default pre-ant time, in ms
entries.Translated: 设置默认蚂蚁边框提前时间，单位毫秒

entries.Original: Set saved pre-ant times to this, in ms
entries.Translated: 将所有已保存的蚂蚁边框提前时间设为此值，单位毫秒

entries.Original:
While you're casting, the game normally reports every action as unusable, which hides all ants.
Enable this to keep ants reflecting each ability's cooldown during a cast, instead of blinking off until the cast ends.
entries.Translated:
施法期间，游戏通常会将所有技能报告为无法使用，从而隐藏所有蚂蚁边框。
启用此项可在施法期间保持蚂蚁边框反映各技能的冷却状态，而不是闪烁消失直到施法结束。
